name: SD: Content moderation (generated by a system dynamics model)
description: A social platform's trust-and-safety dashboard, every hour: active creators, posts waiting for automated screening, posts flagged for human review, moderators on staff, posts in appeal, published posts live in feeds, and removed posts. The data is generated by a system dynamics model of the platform (the ground truth is in sd-moderation/truth.model.json, including a stock the dashboard does not show), so discovery can be checked exactly. Import history or Start, then Discover flows.
